courier-claim:[Demo] Smartwatch.subject: Damage claim: smartwatch reported cracked on delivery
courier-claim:[Demo] Smartwatch.claimedDamage: Crack across the upper left corner of the watch face, reported by the recipient on delivery
courier-claim:[Demo] Smartwatch.body:
Dear claims team,

I am the sender of a parcel containing a smartwatch (declared value 64.00 USD). At handover the watch was declared in "Good, minor scratches" condition with no screen cracks, and it was packed in bubble wrap (S1). After delivery, the recipient reported a crack across the upper left corner of the watch face and provided a photo with a one-time code (B1).

I ask you to review this parcel for damage in transit. The attached records show the declared condition, the packing and the condition reported on delivery. I can provide the original listing photos on request.

timeline.event: Seller packed the watch in bubble wrap; listing photos showed no crack
Recipient photographed a crack across the upper left corner of the watch face

attachments: B1: recipient photo of the cracked watch face
